name: imprint
description: This repository is its own marketplace and carries exactly one plugin: imprint, a set of working rules for multi-agent collaboration and for knowledge that has to stay provable.

plugins.name: imprint
plugins.description: Working rules in two layers: multi-agent collaboration (the delegation contract, the blind first pass, measuring before asserting, the session handover) and recorded knowledge (one canonical place, provenance on entry, superseding instead of deleting, knowledge that ages).
